title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion — Episode8 My Caring Companion

meta.Event Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for today, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only did you give me a ticket, you were nice enough to show us around the fair. We had such a wonderfully fun time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I also had a lot of fun hanging out with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's get together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We could go window-shopping for cute clothes... Oh, we could even try sewing together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Mizuki and I can both be your teachers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound like fun! I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Compared to the rest of you, my dexterity's probably not very good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But since you've invited me, I'd like to give it a try as well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, see you later, Honami, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See you again, Emu, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Things seem so much quieter without them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Mochizuki, that reminds me. Your plan was to head straight for my house, right?
If you're tired, I don't mind if you go home and rest for today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that won't be necessary.
My plan hasn't changed since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we?
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I apologize for making you help me buy and carry over the groceries.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, this is the least I could do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry as well.
I was hoping to split the load with you, but I couldn't even carry half as much as you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's perfectly fine!
I've been doing arm workouts for band, so I feel like I can carry quite a lot now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Now, I'll get started on dinner.
Please feel free to retreat to your room, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'd like to help you with that. I'm sure you're tired after everything that happened today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't be able to relax knowing that you were working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's make dinner together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Just chop down the lines of the onion first, then perpendicular to mince them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow.
But some pieces are sticking to my knife. Does that mean I didn't cut them properly...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You did just fine.
So, would you mind doing one more for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Am I wrong? You're always thinking about what's best for Ms. Yoisaki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You make all this delicious food for her, clean her house, do her laundry... You put your whole heart into it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why I think you're a humongous source of support for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I appreciate what Rin said...
But is that really true...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, what we did today seemed to make Ms. Yoisaki feel a little better...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But does making dinner with her like this really help...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, um...! Not at all!
Oh, I'll get started on the salad. The cabbage is in the refrigerator, yes...? Eep!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A-Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I hit my foot on this chair...
B-But it's nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, we just got back, so you must be tired. Are you sure you don't want to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's actually something I'd like to give you. Please wait here a moment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... O-Of course...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here it is.
I picked out a present for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I asked Mizuki and Otori for some advice because I wasn't sure if I'd be able to choose something you'd like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope you'll accept it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to have a lot of fun today because of you, Ms. Mochizuki, so I wanted to thank you somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's something I felt spending time with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
Having someone next to me with my best interests in mind is such a nice thing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why I felt that I needed to properly show my appreciation for you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I'm at home composing songs by myself, there are times I get so caught up in it that I lose sight of everything else...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you always reach out when that's happening to me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only that, what would normally seem mundane, such as the food you cook and the smell of freshly laundered clothes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's all very comforting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm convinced now that I can keep composing songs because you're there to support me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you for everything you do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Ms. Mochizuki? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, not at all...
I-I'm just so happy that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
Is it alright if I open this now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What a beautiful bouquet... With many different types of flowers too... These white ones look like dahlias, these are bluestars, and I'm seeing a few roses as well...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I saw that there was a bouquet-making workshop, so I decided to make one there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They had so many types of flowers available too. I tried putting this together while asking Mizuki and Emu for some advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Rin was right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'd convinced myself that I really wasn't doing all that much to help...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I was completely wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(What I do does matter.
Staying by Ms. Yoisaki's side helps her in so many different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cooking, cleaning and doing the laundry may seem simple... But I'd like to keep supporting you like this moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll keep having me over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. I wouldn't have it any other way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know I can be a handful at times...
But I'm really glad to have you here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The bouquet Ms. Yoisaki made is so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Just looking at it...
I can sense her kindness.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I know that the pain and sadness Ms. Yoisaki feels won't go away so easily...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I hope her dream of saving others comes true someday...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope she succeeds in saving the person she's trying to help right now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(And eventually...
I hope she can start thinking about her own happiness.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, not eventually. Soon. As soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why I have to keep supporting her.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for this present.
I'm beyond overjoyed!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well then, shall we resume cooking...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Mochizuki. Would you like to have dinner here tonight? I'm sure you've worked up quite an appetite...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It'd seem like a shame if only I got to have this food considering how we made most of it together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
In that case, I'd love to stay...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's continue where we left off... I have to get better at mincing these onions...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You did just fine a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can start making the salad once you've done that. It's very simple to prepare, so you should be able to pick it up quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Then, Ms. Mochizuki, if you don't mind showing me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
